policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV 'we sacrifice unto him' renders the qere וְלוֹ 'unto him'; the textual_variant note 'Another reading is, yet we do not sacrifice' is the ketiv ולא 'not', explicitly set aside as the other reading.

Qere ומבהלים and ketiv ומבלהים differ only by metathesis and both mean 'terrify/trouble'; ASV 'troubled them' fits either, and the note 'Or, terrified' is alternative_rendering about English wording. Base qere carries the projection.
ASV 'the rest of his companions' is plural, matching the qere כְּנָוֺתָיו 'his companions'; the ketiv כנותו is singular 'his companion', which the English excludes.

Qere ארתחששת and ketiv ארתחששתא are spellings of the same royal name; ASV 'Artaxerxes' fits either, and the hebrew_gloss note 'Artahshashta' is a transliteration of the name, not a textual_variant mapped to this spelling. Base qere carries the projection.
Qere ארכויא and ketiv ארכוי are orthographic variants of the same gentilic; ASV 'the Archevites' fits either and no note is mapped. Base qere carries the projection.
ASV 'the Dehaites' renders a people name, i.e. the qere gentilic דֶּהָיֵא; the ketiv דהוא 'that is' would read 'the Shushanchites, that is, the Elamites', which the English does not have.
Qere ובישתא and ketiv ובאישתא are spellings of the same adjective 'bad'; ASV 'the bad city' fits either and no note is mapped. Base qere carries the projection.
Qere ושוריא and ketiv ושורי are both plural 'walls' differing in state/orthography; ASV 'the walls' fits either and no note is mapped. Base qere carries the projection.
Qere שכלילו and ketiv אשכללו are alternative forms of the same verb 'to finish/complete'; ASV 'have finished' fits either and no note is mapped. Base qere carries the projection.
Qere ארתחששת and ketiv ארתחששתא are spellings of the same royal name; ASV 'king Artaxerxes' fits either and no note is mapped to this verse. Base qere carries the projection.
